title: SingPost's postal service quality standards and customer feedback
asked: Ms Hany Soh asked for the trend in SingPost's compliance with IMDA's Postal Quality of Service standards over the past three years, whether IMDA has received feedback on SingPost's service quality, and if so, the three highest categories of that feedback.
response: Mr Tan Kiat How said SingPost has consistently met the Postal Quality of Service standards over the years, with compliance data published on IMDA's website. In 2025, IMDA received 23 pieces of feedback on postal service quality, all relating to misdelivered letters and delays in letter delivery, with similar trends in 2023 and 2024. On supplementary questions, he said IMDA uses an external independent assessor to run quarterly simulated letter tests, and that Singapore's QoS requirements are among the most stringent compared with other countries.
